history.title: Brick Bounce
history.summary: Brick Bounce - minimal breakout clone with paddle, ball, bricks, lives, win/lose states

feedback.gripe: missing lives UI, unclear red line on game over, frame ghosting
feedback.wish: something a bit bigger would be nice, maybe some animations, sprites, sound, etc

history.title: Nebula Drift
history.summary: Nebula Drift - top-down arena survival shooter with momentum thrust and dash, 4 enemy types incl. a Warden boss every 5th wave, energy-orb charged screen-clearing pulse, combo multiplier, power-up drops (repair/rapid/charge), particle VFX, screen shake, procedural animated sprites, and dependency-free synth audio

feedback.replayability: 7-8, yes - replayed to wave 21 before boredom set in
feedback.gripe: Only the fast small yellow enemies (Darters) and the boss were a real threat, and the boss could be trivially avoided by dashing. Dash should grant i-frames and should not collide with enemies you dash through/past. Some sounds felt off - boss hit sounds were too light. Biggest structural gripe: by wave 21 there was nothing new and no progression; difficulty needed to ramp faster and the game needed a roguelite-style upgrade system to stay enjoyable long term.
feedback.wish: Dash i-frames + phase-through, punchier/harder-hitting boss hit audio, faster difficulty ramp, roguelite progression/upgrades for long-term replay

history.title: Lanternfall
history.summary: Lanternfall - turn-based tactics roguelite on procedurally generated floating isometric islands: 3-hero squad vs 6 enemy types and the Hollow King, light/shroud system with per-pixel dynamic lighting, shoves into the void, tactical AI, 7-island run with upgrade drafts and route choice, 5 biomes, adaptive synth score, tutorial, undo, persistent save

feedback.overall: 7/10 - very fun, will replay and share with friends; not my normal type of game
feedback.fun: 7/10 overall; figuring out the lantern lighting mechanic was cool
feedback.replayability: will be playing it again and sharing with friends; reached island 3
feedback.controls: movement felt tricky - easy to get stuck in one place
feedback.gripe: movement tricky, easy to get stuck in one place
feedback.liked: lantern/lighting mechanic, having music, art style
